## What this lands

- **`web/tests/e2e/capstone-organizer.spec.ts`** — the O1–O4 journey battery,
  walked once per {390, 1440 px} × {JS on, JS off} cell. Every journey
  resolves its targets from the served site itself (the A–Z directory
  supplies the dossier route, the dossier's Next-decisions block the watch
  link, the sites list's own table/CSV links, the research queue the
  draft-bearing task) — nothing fixture-specific is hard-coded, so the
  identical spec runs against the promoted origin. O1: a county/city
  dossier names who runs what — figures, sites list, organizations —
  accepting either named agencies or a typed absence (I8, D-K2-1) with
  every item sourced. O2: the dossier's Next decisions block → the place
  watch page → a valid `.ics` feed (a 0-item feed is a legitimate pass,
  WX-02/03). O3: the no-JS sites list — table, "Download this view" CSV,
  per-compartment licence + attribution lines (ACT-07), and row-level
  coordinate precision states. O4: an absence/gap chip → `/task/<handle>/` —
  the plain-language task, its closing condition, the request template and
  the operator-named submission channel (D-K11-4); when a reached task
  carries no draft, the test finds a draft-bearing task from the queue —
  it never invents one.
- **`web/playwright.capstone-organizer.config.ts`** — the dedicated
  four-project runner (`capstone-1440-js`, `capstone-390-js`,
  `capstone-1440-nojs`, `capstone-390-nojs`).
  `SIG_CAPSTONE_BASE_URL=<promoted-origin>` skips the preview server and
  points the battery at the promoted release — a fixture/preview pass is
  never reported as a live/public pass.
- **`ops/src/ops/capstone_organizer.py` + `sig-ops capstone-organizer`** —
  the `sig.capstone-organizer/1` leg declaration: `journeys-fixture` and
  `cost-ledger` deterministic legs run in this dispatch; `live-journeys`,
  `cost-read` and `walkthrough` are declared `prepared_not_executed`, each
  carrying its named precondition and queueing exit 42 with the verbatim
  OM-19 re-run prompt. `live-journeys` names O1's I8/D-K2-1
  placement/publication gate, O2's WX-02/03 producer dependency, O3's
  ACT-07 attribution ordering and O4's D-K11-4 channel settlement inside
  its precondition. `cost-ledger` emits a `sig.capstone-cost-read/1` over
  the committed spend ledger — month 2026-10 GCP cloud-account bound
  **$100** (estimate upper bound; billing-export rows pending, named never
  summed) → **33% of the $300/month ceiling**; outside-cloud-account rows
  reported ($2 estimate + the $50 declared R2 hard cap named, never
  summed).
- **`docs/build/reports/p37.68c-capstone/`** — `PACKET.md` + `packet.json`
  (the leg ledger) and `WALKTHROUGH.md` (the OP-22 operator walkthrough
  packet: steps, K13 §8 pass criteria, a **blank** record table — no
  operator words invented).
- **`tests/ops/test_capstone_organizer.py`** — 12 contract pins (leg set,
  preconditions, the O1–O4 journey-specific gates, check/run semantics,
  exit-42 posture, cost-read honesty).
- **DEFERRALS `### P37.68c`** — `D-P37.68c-1` (kind V: the promoted-release
  O1–O4 legs + the measured billing-export cost read) and `D-P37.68c-2`
